svg.title: Researcher: a ready-made web research stack
svg.desc: Researcher combines research instructions with four capabilities. WebSearch and WebFetch use the model provider's native search and fetch, or duckduckgo_search and web_fetch where the model has none. SubAgents adds delegate_task, which hands a sub-question to a 'researcher' sub-agent with its own search, fetch and output limits. ToolOutputLimits spills oversized tool results to the run workspace, where read_tool_result reads them.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
